title: Principled Nonlinear Concept Erasure and Steering
abstract: arXiv:2610.32516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learned representations often encode sensitive attributes, such as gender or race, that may be undesirable or unsafe to retain. Concept erasure aims to remove this information while preserving task-relevant content. Existing methods remain incomplete: linear methods provide guarantees only against linear probes, while nonlinear methods achieve stronger empirical erasure but lack formal guarantees and often sacrifice utility. In this work, we introduce a principled conditional autoencoder framework for nonlinear concept erasure. We follow the principle that erasure should remove only the sensitive attribute and nothing else, and we show that, under the stated assumptions, perfect reconstruction together with population-level independence is sufficient for perfect nonlinear guardedness, with preservation guarantees in the imperfect-reconstruction regime. Empirically, we attain a superior utility-erasure trade-off across multiple datasets

translated_title: 原则性非线性概念擦除与引导
translated_abstract: 学习到的表示通常会编码敏感属性，例如性别或种族，这些属性若被保留可能是不可取的或不安全的。概念擦除旨在移除这些信息，同时保留与任务相关的内容。现有方法仍不完善：线性方法仅提供针对线性探针的保证，而非线性方法虽然实现了更强的经验擦除效果，但缺乏正式保证，且常常牺牲模型实用性。在这项工作中，我们为非线性概念擦除引入了一个原则性的条件自编码器框架。我们遵循这样的原则：擦除应当只移除敏感属性而不影响其他内容，并且我们证明，在给定假设下，完美重建结合总体水平的独立性足以实现完美的非线性防护性，同时在不完美重建的情形下也提供保留保证。在实证方面，我们在多个数据集上实现了更优的实用性-擦除权衡。
tldr: 本文提出一个基于条件自编码器的原则性非线性概念擦除框架，从理论上证明完美重建与总体水平独立性足以实现完美的非线性防护保证，并在多个数据集上取得了更优的实用性与擦除效果的平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a principled conditional autoencoder framework for nonlinear concept erasure, theoretically proving that perfect reconstruction combined with population-level independence suffices for perfect nonlinear guardedness, and achieves superior utility-erasure trade-offs across multiple datasets.
